transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um... well... I guess I'm just having some trouble at work. I'm a physician. And... I don't know, lately I just feel like I don't deserve the trust people put in me. I keep... replaying these small clinical imperfections in my head. Like... like they prove I'm a dangerous doctor or something. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Do you find yourself feeling anxious or worried about other things in your life, even when there's no specific reason to be?
No... not really. I don't think so. It's mostly just... what I mentioned. Work. I don't really get anxious about other things.
Have you noticed feeling down, losing interest in things you usually enjoy, or changes in your sleep or appetite outside of these work-related worries?

Yeah, I suppose so. I... I don't really do much anymore outside of work. I used to plan these weekend hikes, take sunrise photos, make big Indonesian dinners for my friends... but for months now, I just... I can't. They just feel like obligations I can't make myself care about. So I just stay home.
Do these feelings of not caring about things and staying home happen most days, or are they more occasional?
I'm... not really sure. I haven't really kept track of it. It just sort of... blends together lately, I guess.
Would you say that these feelings of not caring about things and staying home happen on most days, rather than just once in a while?
I mean... like I just said, I don't really keep track of it. I guess it's probably most days? I just... I haven't really been paying that much attention.
Would you say that these feelings of not caring about things and staying home happen on most days, rather than just once in a while?
I... I don't really know what else to tell you. Like I just said, yeah, probably most days. I just don't really keep a record of it.
Do these feelings of not caring about things and staying home happen nearly every day, and have they been consistent throughout the day, most days?
I... look, we just went over this. Yes. Nearly every day. Consistent throughout the day. I... I don't know why you keep asking me the exact same thing.
Have these feelings of not caring about things and staying home been going on for at least two weeks straight?
I don't know... maybe? I... I'm not checking a calendar. It's just been a while, I guess. I really couldn't tell you if it's been exactly two weeks.
Have these feelings of not caring about things and staying home been going on for at least two weeks straight?
Didn't you... just ask me that? I don't know. Like I said, I'm not keeping track of the exact days.
Can you recall if these feelings of not caring about things and staying home have been happening every day, without much of a break, for at least two weeks in a row?
I... I don't know what else to tell you. We're just going in circles now. I really don't know if it's been exactly two weeks. I'm not keeping track of time like that.
Can you tell me if these feelings of not caring about things and staying home started recently, or if you’ve had similar periods before?
It's... not recent. It's been a lot longer than two weeks. Probably about a year and a month now, I think. It started right after I got this... award at the clinic.
Have you had episodes like this before, where you felt this way for at least two weeks or more?
No... I don't think so. Not before this. It's just been this one long stretch.
Has your current episode of feeling this way lasted for two months or more?
I... yeah. Like I just said, it's been about a year and a month. So... yes.

Before this current period, have you ever had any other times in your life where you felt this way—like you didn’t care about things, lost interest in activities, and stayed home—for at least two weeks?
No... I thought I just answered that. Like I said, no. Just this one long stretch. Nothing before this.
Have you ever had periods where you felt unusually upbeat, energized, or irritable, where you were doing more than usual, talking more, or not needing as much sleep?
No... I haven't had anything like that. Just... no.

Has there ever been a time in your life before this current period where you felt down, lost interest in things, or couldn’t enjoy activities for at least two weeks, and then later felt back to normal before this started again?
I... didn't you just ask me that? No. Like I said... there wasn't anything before this. Just this past year.
